subject: Paired Labs rapid-fire series — sponsorship & ops sync
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@edgeworks.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeWorks Partnerships <partners@edgeworks.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Paired Labs rapid-fire series + sponsorship ask

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for taking a look at this. EdgeWorks would love to pilot a short co-marketing series with Redwood: a paired-labs "rapid-fire" format where both teams run 20-minute hands-on demos back-to-back (30-minute total slot with 10 minutes shared Q&A). Target: engineers/infra platform leads at mid-market/cloud-native companies.

High-level ask from our side:
- Shared booth/demo slot at two regional meetups (SF + NYC) in Q1 (we can flex dates)
- MDF contribution: $25,000 to fund co-branded ads, event booth, and a shared landing page + paid social
- Joint lead share (50/50) + UTM tracking

Attached is a one-pager outline with format and sample agenda (edgeworks-paired-labs-outline.pdf).

If this looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute ops call this week to confirm dates, MDF terms, and who from each side will run the demo labs? Eliza (cc'd via partners alias) will be our ops contact.

Appreciate it — excited about a quick, technical-focused collab.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | EdgeWorks
ela@edgeworks.ai

Attachment: edgeworks-paired-labs-outline.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@edgeworks.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, EdgeWorks Partnerships <partners@edgeworks.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Paired Labs rapid-fire series + sponsorship ask

Elena —

Love the concept. A few quick questions before the ops call so we come prepared:

- Attendee profile: can you confirm T-shirt sizing (j/k) — meaning target titles/IC level (SREs, infra eng, platform leads)?
- Expected registration volume per city (ballpark) so we can plan staffing and lead-handling
- Co-branding: do you have a preferred logo lockup or do you want to follow Redwood templates?
- MDF: we have existing guidance (typical MDF floor for new partners is $15k). If EdgeWorks needs $25k, we should surface what the incremental budget covers (ads, paid socials, booth build).

From Redwood: we can commit two engineers (engineering demo leads) for each city and a 1-pager + a post-event on-demand recording. Suggested slot: 20 + 20 (two demos) with 10 min Q&A — keeps it energetic.

Can you share the mutual action plan (MAP) ahead of the call? If you can drop the MAP link and your preferred dates, I'll get Marissa and Ben to confirm availability. Tentative ops call windows: Wed 12/2 9–11am PT or Thu 12/3 1–4pm PT.

Thanks — forwarding to Marissa and Ben to flag any calendar or MDF policy constraints.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeWorks Partnerships <partners@edgeworks.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Paired Labs rapid-fire series — sponsorship & ops sync

Thanks Jonas — looping marketing ops in early. Quick operational notes before the call:

- MDF: our standard floor for co-marketing test pilots is $15,000. Anything above that needs a short business case and approval from Partnerships (Jonas) + Finance.
- Invoicing: Redwood prefers a 50% deposit up front / 50% net-30 after event. We can do exceptions but need procurement sign-off.
- Lead handling: we require one shared webhook + a shared CSV export within 48 hours. Please confirm EdgeWorks can post to our webhook endpoint.
- Tracking: UTM + a shared promo code optional for attribution.
- Creative: please provide final co-branding assets 10 business days before the first event. Acceptable formats: PNG/SVG for logos; we prefer the lockup in the attached co-branding-guidelines.png.

I've dropped a draft of MDF terms for partners in the attachment (draft-MDF-Terms-EdgeWorks.pdf). Please review the funding line items — ads are capped at 40% of MDF unless pre-approved.

Calendar availability for an ops call: Wed 12/2 9:30–10:00am PT (15–30m) works if Jonas can cover product/partnership ask. If EdgeWorks needs more time, we should book 30m.

cc: Marissa for demand-gen alignment and Ben for field ops headcount planning.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Marketing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment: draft-MDF-Terms-EdgeWorks.pdf (pdf); co-branding-guidelines.png (image)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@edgeworks.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeWorks Partnerships <partners@edgeworks.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Paired Labs rapid-fire series — sponsorship & ops sync

Thanks all — good clarity. Quick responses inline: 

- Attendee profile: SREs, platform engineers, infra/ML infra leads (mid-market & up). Target registration: 150–250 per city (conservative).
- MDF: we can accept Redwood's $15,000 floor for a pilot. Given that, EdgeWorks will co-fund an additional $10k earmarked for paid social to hit our attendee targets. We'll share a short budget breakdown on the MAP.
- Lead flow: EdgeWorks can post to Redwood's webhook; we'll also provide a mirror CSV export within 48 hours for backup.
- Creative & logos: we'll deliver assets 12 business days before the first event; can follow your lockup guidance.

Proposed dates (tentative):
- SF: week of Feb 9, 2027 (Thu preferred)
- NYC: week of Mar 2, 2027 (Wed preferred)

MAP link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB-EdgeWorks-MAP — draft includes budget split, targeting, and responsibilities. We'll circulate a signed SOW next week.

We can take the shorter 30-minute ops call on Wed 12/2 at 9:30am PT to confirm the MDF agreement and timeline (Jonas/Kimberly/Marissa/Ben on the Redwood side).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get this into motion.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | EdgeWorks
elena@edgeworks.ai
